title: Certified Neural Approximation of Robust Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.29559v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model predictive control is a high-performance control method, but it incurs comparatively high online computational costs across many control tasks and is challenging to realize in low-level hardware settings. To address this, we present a framework for generating neural network controllers that provably inherit the safety and stability guarantees of a robust model predictive policy. In contrast to approaches based on post-verification or additional online safety filters, our method provides constructive, a priori design conditions that ensure preservation of recursive feasibility and stability before deployment. We treat the approximation error as a bounded input disturbance, which is addressed in the MPC design. This allows the neural network controller to directly inherit robustness from the underlying model predictive controller, which enables the transfer of guarantees to the approximation. translated_title: 鲁棒非线性模型预测控制的认证神经近似
translated_abstract: 模型预测控制是一种高性能的控制方法，但在许多控制任务中其在线计算成本相对较高，且难以在底层硬件环境中实现。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个框架，用于生成能够以可证明的方式继承鲁棒模型预测策略的安全性和稳定性保证的神经网络控制器。与基于事后验证或额外在线安全过滤器的方法不同，我们的方法提供了构造性的、先验的设计条件，确保在部署之前递归可行性和稳定性得以保持。我们将近似误差视为有界输入扰动，并在MPC设计中加以处理。这使得神经网络控制器能够直接从底层模型预测控制器继承鲁棒性，从而将保证传递到神经近似中。该设计过程是一个离线的、……
tldr: 该论文提出一个框架，通过将近似误差作为有界输入扰动纳入鲁棒MPC设计，提供先验的构造性设计条件，使神经网络控制器在部署前即可继承模型预测控制的递归可行性与稳定性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a framework for generating neural network controllers that provably inherit the recursive feasibility and stability guarantees of robust model predictive control, by treating the approximation error as a bounded input disturbance addressed within the MPC design.
